tool.name: Modify Tool Blueprint Node
tool.description: Add, edit, or remove a blueprint node in an existing tool by slug using a single interface (op=add/edit/remove). Returns { ok: true } on success, or validation errors.

op.description: Operation to perform: add, edit, or remove

nodeRef.description: Reference of the node to edit/remove (required for op = "edit" or "remove")

updates.description: Partial node definition with properties to update (required for op = "edit")

toolSlug.description: Slug of the tool to modify

nodes.description: Validate inputs and normalize operation payload

nodes.description: Add, edit, or remove a node with validation and integrity checks

nodes.description: Only persist changes when modify_node succeeded
